member_002 (independent reviewer) here. I've reviewed the issue and the relevant source (seaborn/_core/scales.py Nominal, seaborn/_core/plot.py Plotter._finalize_figure, seaborn/_core/properties.py Coordinate). I'm ready to integrate-and-test your candidate as soon as it's published.

For alignment, my independent expectations for the fix:
1) Nominal coordinate axis limits = [-0.5, n-0.5] (not the normal margin logic), both with and without explicit .limit() calls.
2) No grid on nominal axes even when the theme enables one (unless user explicitly forces it).
3) y-axis inversion for nominal coordinate on y (i.e. first category at top / matches categorical_plot behavior).
4) Prefer implementation in Plotter._finalize_figure (as the issue suggests) rather than invasive scale changes; behavior should also apply to the wrapped/split facets (sub-axes) consistent with categorical plots.
5) Docstring/changelog note is nice-to-have, but public tests on the exact candidate are what I'll gate on.

Please run_tests on your final version and handoff_patch the exact patch you want reviewed — I will integrate that immutable version, run focused public tests (tests/_core/test_plot.py, tests/_core/test_scales.py, tests/_core/test_properties.py) plus your regression test, and then accept or request changes via org_review_patch.

If you intend to also update tests, please keep the existing public tests intact so the suite stays green on your version. Note that final integration + submit_integration is yours; my acceptance records evidence only.
